prompt: In some countries, cash is being replaced almost entirely by digital payment. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
In many countries nowadays, the people are not using the cash anymore and they are paying by the cards and the mobile phones. Some persons are saying this is a good change but some are not agree. I think this development is mostly positive because it is very convenient.

Firstly, the digital payment is very fast and easy. We do not need to carry the heavy wallet and we do not need to find the change every time. Also, if the person is losing the cash, the money is gone forever, but if the card is lost, we can block it immediately, so it is more safe. Moreover, all the transactions are recorded, so the government can catch the black money and the tax evasion is reducing.

Secondly, there are also some problems. The old people are not knowing how to use the smartphones and they are facing many difficulties in the shops. Also, in the villages the internet connection is very poor, and if the server is down, nobody can buy the anything. Some people are also worried about the privacy, because the companies can see all the purchases of the customer. And if somebody is not having the smartphone, then he can not buy anything in such type of shops.

In conclusion, in my opinion this is a positive development because it is convenient, safe and it is helping the government, but the banks and the government should also help the old people and the villages, so that everybody can use this system.
title: Cash disappearing in favour of digital payment
